029/**
030 * Base class for HTTP error response exceptions (4xx and 5xx) in the {@code org.apache.juneau.http} stack.
031 *
032 * <p>
033 * Extends {@link RuntimeException} while also implementing {@link HttpResponseMessage}, so that HTTP
034 * error responses can be both thrown as exceptions and used as response objects. Provides classic-style
035 * fluent setters that mutate state and return {@code this}.
036 *
037 * <p>
038 * Immutability is expressed with the "funnel + nested {@code Unmodifiable} snapshot" paradigm: every mutator routes
039 * through the single protected {@link #modify(Runnable)} choke-point, and each concrete leaf gets a nested
040 * {@code X.Unmodifiable} whose only behavioral override is a throwing {@code modify(...)}.  A leaf's
041 * {@link #unmodifiable()} factory returns a point-in-time snapshot; any attempt to set a property on it throws an
042 * {@link UnsupportedOperationException}.
043 *
044 * <p>
045 * This is a {@link Throwable}-rooted hierarchy, so (unlike {@link BasicHttpResponse}) it cannot be a self-typed (CRTP)
046 * root — JLS &sect;8.1.2 forbids a generic {@code Throwable}.  The funnel therefore returns the base type and each leaf
047 * keeps its covariant setter overrides.
048 *
049 * <p>
050 * <b>Beta — API subject to change:</b> This type is part of the next-generation REST client and HTTP stack
051 * ({@code org.apache.juneau.marshall.ng.*}).
052 * It is not API-frozen: binary- and source-incompatible changes may appear in the <b>next major</b> Juneau release
053 * (and possibly earlier).
054 *
055 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
056 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/NextGenRestClient">juneau-ng REST client</a>
057 * </ul>
058 *
059 * @since 9.2.1
060 */
061@SuppressWarnings({
062   "java:S3008", // Concrete subclasses use UPPER_CASE singleton instance constants (e.g., INSTANCE fields).
063   "java:S1948", // HttpHeaderList is not Java-serializable; HTTP exceptions are not designed for Java serialization transport.
064   "java:S1165"  // Mutable exception fields are intentional: HTTP exceptions support builder-style fluent setters.
065})
066public class BasicHttpException extends RuntimeException implements HttpResponseMessage {
067
068   private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
069
070   private HttpStatusLine statusLine;
071   private HttpHeaderList headers;
072   private HttpBody body;
073   private Locale locale;
074
075   /**
076    * Constructor with no message body.
077    *
078    * @param statusCode The HTTP status code.
079    * @param reasonPhrase The reason phrase (e.g. {@code "Internal Server Error"}). May be <jk>null</jk>.
080    */
081   public BasicHttpException(int statusCode, String reasonPhrase) {
082      this(statusCode, reasonPhrase, (Throwable)null, (String)null);
083   }
084
085   /**
086    * Constructor with a status code and a cause.
087    *
088    * @param statusCode The HTTP status code.
089    * @param reasonPhrase The reason phrase. May be <jk>null</jk>.
090    * @param cause The cause. May be <jk>null</jk>.
091    */
092   public BasicHttpException(int statusCode, String reasonPhrase, Throwable cause) {
093      this(statusCode, reasonPhrase, cause, cause != null ? cause.getMessage() : null);
094   }
095
096   /**
097    * Constructor with a {@link String#format(String, Object...) String.format}-style message body.
098    *
099    * @param statusCode The HTTP status code.
100    * @param reasonPhrase The reason phrase. May be <jk>null</jk>.
101    * @param msg The exception message and response body. May be <jk>null</jk>.
102    *    Treated as a {@link String#format(String, Object...) String.format}-style format string (<c>%s</c> placeholders) when {@code args} is non-empty.
103    * @param args Optional message arguments.
104    */
105   public BasicHttpException(int statusCode, String reasonPhrase, String msg, Object...args) {
106      this(statusCode, reasonPhrase, (Throwable)null, msg, args);
107   }
108
109   /**
110    * Constructor with a cause and a {@link String#format(String, Object...) String.format}-style message body.
111    *
112    * @param statusCode The HTTP status code.
113    * @param reasonPhrase The reason phrase. May be <jk>null</jk>.
114    * @param cause The cause. May be <jk>null</jk>.
115    * @param msg The exception message. May be <jk>null</jk>.
116    *    Treated as a {@link String#format(String, Object...) String.format}-style format string (<c>%s</c> placeholders) when {@code args} is non-empty.
117    * @param args Optional message arguments.
118    */
119   public BasicHttpException(int statusCode, String reasonPhrase, Throwable cause, String msg, Object...args) {
120      super(formatMessage(msg, args), cause);
121      this.statusLine = HttpStatusLineBean.of(statusCode, reasonPhrase);
122      this.headers = HttpHeaderList.create();
123      var m = formatMessage(msg, args);
124      this.body = m != null ? StringBody.of(m) : null;
125   }
126
127   private static String formatMessage(String msg, Object...args) {
128      if (msg == null)
129         return null;
130      if (args == null || args.length == 0)
131         return msg;
132      return f(msg, args);
133   }
134
135   /**
136    * Copy constructor.
137    *
138    * <p>
139    * The mutable sub-beans are deep-copied by <b>direct field assignment</b>, never through a funneled setter.  This is
140    * the snapshot path used by {@link #unmodifiable()}: the constructor runs inside an {@code Unmodifiable} instance
141    * whose {@link #modify(Runnable)} already throws, so a setter-based copy would blow up during construction.
142    *
143    * @param copyFrom The instance to copy. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
144    */
145   protected BasicHttpException(BasicHttpException copyFrom) {
146      super(assertArgNotNull("copyFrom", copyFrom).getMessage(), copyFrom.getCause());
147      this.statusLine = copyFrom.statusLine;
148      this.headers = copyFrom.headers.copy();
149      this.body = copyFrom.body;
150      this.locale = copyFrom.locale;
151   }
152

164      return u(headers);

171
172   @Override /* Throwable */
173   public String getMessage() {
174      var m = super.getMessage();
175      if (m == null && getCause() != null)
176         m = getCause().getMessage();
177      if (m == null)
178         m = statusLine.getReasonPhrase();
179      return m;
180   }

357   /**
358    * Returns whether this instance is an unmodifiable snapshot.
359    *
360    * @return <jk>true</jk> if this bean is an {@link UnmodifiableBean} snapshot.
361    */
362   public boolean isUnmodifiable() {
363      return this instanceof UnmodifiableBean;
364   }
365
366   /**
367    * Returns an unmodifiable snapshot of this bean.
368    *
369    * <p>
370    * The returned instance is a point-in-time copy of the leaf's nested {@code Unmodifiable} type; any attempt to set a
371    * property on it throws an {@link UnsupportedOperationException}.  This method is idempotent: if this bean is already
372    * unmodifiable it returns itself rather than taking another snapshot.  The receiver is left unchanged (and still
373    * modifiable unless it was already unmodifiable).
374    *
375    * @return An unmodifiable snapshot of this bean, or this bean if it is already unmodifiable.
376    */
377   public BasicHttpException unmodifiable() {
378      return this instanceof Unmodifiable ? this : new Unmodifiable(this);
379   }

381   // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
382   // Stack/cause helpers
383   // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
384
385   /**
386    * Returns the root cause of this exception.
387    *
388    * <p>
389    * The root cause is the first exception in the init-cause parent chain that's not one of the following:
390    * <ul>
391    *    <li>{@link BasicHttpException}
392    *    <li>{@link InvocationTargetException}
393    * </ul>
394    *
395    * @return The root cause of this exception, or <jk>null</jk> if no root cause was found.
396    */
397   public Throwable getRootCause() {
398      Throwable t = this;
399      while (nn(t)) {
400         if (! (t instanceof BasicHttpException || t instanceof InvocationTargetException))
401            return t;
402         t = t.getCause();
403      }
404      return null;
405   }
406
407   /**
408    * Returns all error messages from all errors in this exception's cause chain joined into a single string.
409    *
410    * @param scrubForXssVulnerabilities
411    *    If {@code true}, replaces {@code <}, {@code >}, and {@code &} characters with spaces.
412    * @return A multi-line string of messages. Never <jk>null</jk>.
413    */
414   public String getFullStackMessage(boolean scrubForXssVulnerabilities) {
415      var msg = getMessage();
416      var sb = new StringBuilder();
417      if (nn(msg)) {
418         if (scrubForXssVulnerabilities)
419            msg = msg.replace('<', ' ').replace('>', ' ').replace('&', ' ');
420         sb.append(msg);
421      }
422      var e = getCause();
423      while (nn(e)) {
424         msg = e.getMessage();
425         if (nn(msg) && scrubForXssVulnerabilities)
426            msg = msg.replace('<', ' ').replace('>', ' ').replace('&', ' ');
427         var cls = cns(e);
428         if (msg == null)
429            sb.append(f("\nCaused by (%s)", cls));
430         else
431            sb.append(f("\nCaused by (%s): %s", cls, msg));
432         e = e.getCause();
433      }
434      return sb.toString();
435   }

437   // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
438   // Immutability paradigm plumbing
439   // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
440
441   /**
442    * Single mutation funnel — the only choke-point through which all state changes on this bean flow.
443    *
444    * <p>
445    * Every fluent setter routes through this method.  The nested {@code Unmodifiable} snapshot overrides only this
446    * method to throw, which freezes the entire mutation surface with a single override.  Because this is a
447    * {@link Throwable}-rooted hierarchy (no CRTP self-type), the funnel returns the base type.
448    *
449    * @param mutation The state change to apply.
450    * @return This object.
451    */
452   protected BasicHttpException modify(Runnable mutation) {
453      mutation.run();
454      return this;
455   }
456
457   /**
458    * Deep-freeze hook invoked from the nested {@code Unmodifiable} constructor after the snapshot copy completes.
459    *
460    * <p>
461    * The mutable sub-beans are frozen here by <b>direct field assignment</b> (never via a setter, which would route
462    * through the throwing {@link #modify(Runnable)} and blow up during construction).  A leaf that adds its own mutable
463    * sub-bean overrides this method (calling {@code super.freeze()} first).
464    */
465   protected void freeze() {
466      headers = headers.unmodifiable();   // DIRECT field write — snapshot the copied HttpHeaderList.
467   }
468
469   @Override /* Object */
470   public boolean equals(Object o) {
471      // D3 content equality.  The 'body' HttpBody is deliberately excluded: it is a wrapper without value semantics
472      // and is derived from the message (getMessage()), which is already compared here.
473      return o instanceof BasicHttpException other && eq(this, other, (x, y) ->
474         eq(x.statusLine, y.statusLine) && eq(x.headers, y.headers) && eq(x.getMessage(), y.getMessage()));
475   }
476
477   @Override /* Object */
478   public int hashCode() {
479      return h(statusLine, headers, getMessage());
480   }
481
482   @Override /* Object */
483   public String toString() {
484      return statusLine.toString();
485   }
486
487   /**
488    * Unmodifiable point-in-time snapshot of the enclosing {@link BasicHttpException}.
489    *
490    * <p>
491    * Its only behavioral override is {@link #modify(Runnable)}, which throws — because all mutation is funneled through
492    * {@code modify(...)}, this single override freezes the entire mutation surface.
493    */
494   public static class Unmodifiable extends BasicHttpException implements UnmodifiableBean {
495
496      private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
497
498      /**
499       * Constructor.
500       *
501       * @param copyFrom The exception to snapshot.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
502       */
503      @SuppressWarnings({
504         "java:S1699" // Paradigm intentionally calls the overridable freeze() from the ctor to deep-freeze sub-beans.
505      })
506      protected Unmodifiable(BasicHttpException copyFrom) {
507         super(copyFrom);
508         freeze();
509      }
510
511      @Override /* Overridden from BasicHttpException */
512      protected BasicHttpException modify(Runnable mutation) {
513         throw uoex("Bean is unmodifiable.");
514      }
515   }
516}
